_README: Copy to model-card.json ONLY after you have placed a real converted model (model.json + shards) here and filled EVERY field from the model's real documentation. Do not guess any value.
name: FILL: exact model name
source: FILL: URL of the model's page
license: FILL: license stated by the author (if none is stated, you may not have the right to redistribute it)
trainingData: FILL: dataset description and size, from the author
species: FILL: species the training data covers
labels: FILL: class names in the exact output order
